ablations.description: Phase 1.12 baseline configuration without genus protection, transitive gating, or new domain invariants
Baseline + Genus abbreviation sentence segmentation protection (prevents clause severance on P./M./S./E. genus names)
Baseline + CrossPageLinker domain invariant gating (terminal phenotype sink filtering and TCSTS reverse pair rejection)
Baseline + Causal grounding filters (exploratory potential objective pruning, T3SS/opsonophagocytosis invariants, attenuated negation)
Phase 1.13 Production configuration (Full combination of genus protection, transitive invariant gating, and causal grounding filters)
